| # bds_sec_getSeed {#bds_sec_getseed-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This function is used to request a seed value (random Number with 128Bit). The random number is generated by the Hardware Security Module (HSM) of the RC.

 

This API is actually not supported for CODESYS and can not be used.

## ![hmtoggle_plus1](hmtoggle_plus1.gif){#toggle0186a1_ICON .dropdown-toggle-icon style="margin:0;width:0.1042in;height:0.0938in;border:none"} [FFI](javascript:HMToggle('toggle','toggle0186a1','toggle0186a1_ICON')){.dropdown-toggle style="font-style: normal; font-weight: normal; color: #002b49; background-color: transparent; text-decoration: none;"} {#hmtoggle_plus1-ffi .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  This API can be used in trusted partitions only. See [Freedom from Interference (FFI) concept](freedom-from-interference.html){.topiclink} for more details.
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
